artworks.title: The Destruction of the Egyptian Idols [verso]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various medieval scenes with figures and text. The image is comprised of multiple vignette-style illustrations, separated into panels. Each panel contains characters engaged in activities or interacting with each other, often accompanied by handwritten text in a script typical of medieval manuscripts. The scenes contain details such as figures in robes, with some holding objects that resemble books or scrolls. The illustrations also feature architectural elements like columns, suggesting settings within interiors or significant buildings. The overall drawing style highlights delicate line work and a focus on narrative storytelling through visual elements.

artworks.title: Saint Filippo Benizzi Healing a Beggar
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape with a group of figures. The scene features clouds at the top, a barren tree in the center, and rocky terrain. Various groups of figures are positioned in classical poses across different parts of the image. Some are shown in discussion while others interact with the environment. Architectural elements in the distance break the horizon to the right. The figures' garments and features suggest a narrative unfolding in the stylized natural landscape.

artworks.title: The Inferno, after the Fresco in the Camposanto of Pisa
artworks.description: This print shows a hellish scene with figures in different levels of punishment. Four distinct layers are visible, each filled with nude human figures and demonic creatures. On each of the layers, humans are tormented by the demonic creatures: wrapped in snakes, stabbed with pitchforks, dismembered, eaten by beasts, poked with pitchforks, or roasted on spits. Behind all these scenes, the background is filled with overlapping flames. A large, monstrous figure in the center of the print with horns, scaly limbs, and clawed feet appears to be eating humans. The lines of the print are black, and the background is off-white paper.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child on the Grassy Bank
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a seated woman holding a child on her lap. The woman is positioned slightly turned to her left, with her head lowered toward the child. She has long, wavy hair, and wears a crown and an intricately patterned robe. The child is reaching up with one hand. Both figures wear halos. The background includes tall grasses, a natural setting, and a distant structure among trees and hills. The scene is framed in a style reminiscent of a medieval or early renaissance woodcut.

artworks.title: Women's Bath
artworks.description: Printed with regular, hatched lines and shading on cream-white paper, six nude women and two children gather and bathe on and around a platform in a wood-paneled room in this square woodcut. A woman at the bottom center of the composition kneels and looks at us, her body facing out as she tips her head to her right and smiles. She wears a brimless, flaring cap. She reaches into a low-sided pail by one hip with her left hand, to our right, and touches the back of a portly woman with her other hand. That second woman sits facing our left in profile. She wears a straight-sided cap as she looks into the distance. Two women behind this pair have long, loose hair. One stands and holds up a tool, like a bundle of leaves or feathers, over her head so it touches the far shoulder. The other sits on the platform and touches her hair, also looking at us. The fifth woman, behind her, stands with her body facing us but she looks up and to our left. Her hair is pulled back under a headdress and one arm crosses her chest. The sixth woman stands next to the first with one foot on the floor and one propped up on a stool to our right. She stands with her back to us and reaches with her right hand to scratch the underside of her right buttock. Two children look at the group from just beyond the stool. Jugs, buckets, brushes, and other tools lie on and around the platform. Another person enters from a door on the far wall near the right edge of the sheet. That far wall and ceiling are paneled with wood. An arched oven and a jug with spigots are in the back left corner.

artworks.title: Saint Amelberga
artworks.description: This is a black and white image of a religious figure standing in an architectural setting. The drawing features an individual in long, flowing robes, standing before a columned archway. In the background, there are stylized mountain peaks and trees. The figure has a halo of light around their head and there are emblems featuring crosses and other designs on the sides of the image. The inscription below reads "Sancta Amelberga."

artworks.title: Saint Guilhelmus
artworks.artist: Cornelis Liefrinck I, after Leonhard Beck
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing on a rocky ground in a forest. He is leaning on a large staff with his right hand and holding a hatchet in his left. He has a long white beard and wears a hooded cape over a long robe. There is an aureole around his head. A basket and a shield with fleur-de-lis are in the foreground. Trees and foliage surround him, and distant hills, a castle, and light clouds are in the background.

artworks.title: Saint Brigitta
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted in the image. The figure on the right is standing facing the other figure. They are dressed in a robe and a hooded cloak, holding a staff or cross-like object. The person on the left is kneeling, wearing a detailed outfit with knee-high boots. In the background, there are buildings, including a tower and a shield with a lion design.

artworks.title: Saint Colomannus
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright. He is facing slightly to the left with his body in profile. The man has a long beard, long, wavy hair, and a contemplative expression. He wears a distinctive hat with a cross motif and a halo around his head. He is dressed in a long robe with a belt, holds a staff in his left hand, and grasps a chain in his right hand. Surrounding him are landscapes with rugged terrain, trees, and a flowing river. In the foreground, there is an emblem with a lion motif and a crown on the ground near his feet. The background shows hills, mountains, and distant architectural structures, implying a town or village setting.

artworks.title: Saint Dentalinus
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclining on a large bed. The person is seated with plush pillows behind them, wavy hair neatly arranged, and hands near the chest. They wear a voluminous gown, without visible jewelry. The bed has a canopy and the room features an archway with a coffered ceiling. In the background, there is a tapestry with coats of arms, a pedestal with lattice, and a hovering dove emitting light rays. The setting includes a tiled floor and a small table with items next to the bed.

artworks.title: Saint Emericus
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing indoors, viewed from the back. The person's head is turned slightly to the left. They have medium-length hair peeking out from beneath a hat with intricate details. The person is wearing a long robe with fur trim around the shoulders. They are holding a tall shield decorated with an emblem featuring a cross and a heraldic lion. Beside them is a tall column with a similar shield design. The background features structured architecture with archways and tiled flooring. Above eye level, there is an apparition of a mother figure holding a child surrounded by clouds and a halo.

artworks.title: Saint Goericus
artworks.description: This is an image featuring a cloaked figure with an intricate design and a celestial scene. The central figure is cloaked in elaborate fabric with detailed patterns. Above the figure, an angelic being with wings and flowing robes hovers amidst swirling clouds. In the background, there is a cityscape with towers and buildings. On the right side, a tree with detailed foliage is shown, with a shield bearing a lion emblem hanging from its branches. Near the lower left corner, a crown is seen amidst foliage. The composition is rich in symbolism and detail, reminiscent of medieval or Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Saint Gudila
artworks.description: The image shows a person with a halo around their head wearing a robe and veil. They are holding a candle in one hand and have the other hand raised in a gesture. Beside them, a winged creature is reaching towards the candle. In the background are arched windows, a shield with a lion design, and two spiral columns. The scene is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Saint Jodocus
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in the center. He has a long face, straight hair, and wears a halo. He is dressed in layered clothing with a cloak and is holding a walking stick in his left hand and his cloak in his right hand. He wears a cross necklace and a crown is on the floor in front of him. The setting includes architectural elements and a landscape with buildings and hills in the background. A crest with various symbols is in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Saint Leo (Pope Leo IX)
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure dressed in ecclesiastical clothing standing next to a person in bed. The standing figure is elegantly robed, holding a staff and wearing a tiara. The individual in bed is partially visible, with their head resting on a hand and covered by a blanket. The background shows a brick wall with a coat of arms and two arched windows with an exterior view.

artworks.title: Saint Ramaricus
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure of a person standing in a forest. The person is turned slightly to the right with one hand raised to their chest and the other holding a string of beads. The figure has a long beard and is wearing a hooded robe that obscures their hair. The person's facial features appear aged and contemplative. The clothing is simple and covers the entire body except for the feet, which are bare. Surrounding the figure is a detailed backdrop of a forest with trees and foliage. In the background, a castle or a series of buildings can be seen on a hill under a cloudy sky. There is a shield featuring a stylized lion on the bottom left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Saint Rudolfus
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a long beard standing upright. He has a serious expression, a crown, long hair, and a flowing robe. He is holding a staff in one hand and a banner in the other, which reads "IHS" in a sunburst. Next to him is a heraldic panel on a wall with a coat of arms. In the background, there is a landscape with hills, trees, and a church steeple visible through an arched window under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Saint Rupertus
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a regal stance, looking upwards towards an angelic figure in the clouds. The person is adorned in armor, a crown, and holds a staff. Surrounding them are medieval-style buildings, a tree, and a coat of arms.

artworks.title: Saint Sigismundus
artworks.description: The image depicts three people. The central figure is standing, holding a sword and a scepter, adorned with a crown and a halo. They wear intricate attire. Two smaller figures wearing crowns stand on either side. Nearby are a column with a heraldic shield and a statue in a robe. The background shows a cobblestone pavement, architectural elements, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Saint Verona
artworks.description: The image shows a woodcut illustration with two figures in an outdoor architectural setting. One figure is kneeling on the ground, holding a walking stick and dressed in tattered clothing. The second figure, standing, has a halo and is pouring liquid from a jug into the kneeling figure's hand. The background features intricate architectural structures, including arches, columns, towers, and a distant fountain, within a walled area resembling a courtyard or city setting.

artworks.title: Saint Walpurgis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a side profile on a shoreline. She wears a robe with a draped head covering. Her face is partially visible. Her hair is tucked under the headpiece. She holds a small object and stands beside a shield with crowns. In the background, there is a sailing ship with masts and sails on the sea. Figures on the ship are dressed in period clothing. The foreground features rocky terrain and a crown near the woman’s feet. Trees are behind her, and in the distance, a cityscape with a church, other buildings, and cloudy skies is visible.

artworks.title: Saint Willibaldus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large, robed figure with a halo and a bishop's mitre in a forest with buildings in the background. The figure holds a staff and stands with an arm outstretched and a kneeling person with an axe. The background shows detailed architecture and a shield with a decorative pattern. The scene is rendered in a highly detailed, woodcut style with fine lines and crosshatching.

artworks.title: The Banquet of the Piacevoli
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with numerous figures engaged in various activities. The room is grand, with tall ceilings, wooden beams, chandeliers, draped curtains, large windows, framed art pieces, and opulent furniture. The detailed line work captures movement and interaction.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Entry into Rome of His Excellency the Polish Ambassador"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand procession or parade. The scene captures a detailed composition featuring a number of figures and animals in a ceremonial setting. To the left, texts are inscribed vertically and horizontally. Dominating the illustration is a column of camels and horses adorned ornately, led by robed figures. The background depicts a bustling cityscape.
